answer.rationale: Primary supply expires in 14 days with no auto-renew and the line is at 94% with no buffer, so defer_decision or add_second_source as the single action would leave the incumbent contract uncovered and raise delivery risk. switch_primary_vendor could pursue the 18% spend cut (c2) but onboarding against zero buffer would increase delivery risk and violate the objective constraint. renew_incumbent (c1) protects continuity but cannot meet the cost mandate after an explicit refusal to reopen price. Negotiation at this expiry, using prior renewal benchmarking (c4) and multi-year volume pricing (c6), is the remaining path that can reduce TCO without changing supplier. Verifying c4 because the current refusal may limit how far that renewal playbook still applies.
